claim: TSMC's second-largest customer (identified by industry reporting as Nvidia) grew from 11% of net revenue in 2023 to 12% in 2024 to 17% in 2025 -- nearly closing the gap with the largest customer (19% vs 17% in 2025), corroborating the AI/HPC displacement of Apple's historical anchor-customer dominance.

quoted_support: Our second largest customer in 2023, 2024 and 2025 accounted for 11%, 12%, and 17% of our net revenue in the respective year.
